FinancialPhraseBank.label_provenance: Human annotators with a finance background. At least 50% agreement.
FinancialPhraseBank.label_level: Investor-view sentiment of a financial-news sentence, not a general headline.

SemEval-2007 Task 14.licence: Shared-task data redistributed by MichiganNLP/Affective-Text-Individual-Annotations. No separate licence file is in that mirror.
SemEval-2007 Task 14.label_provenance: Six human annotators gave valence from -100 to 100. The mean is mapped with the task's own coarse bins: <= -50 negative, >= 50 positive, otherwise neutral.
SemEval-2007 Task 14.label_level: Sentiment of the whole news headline.

EmoBank newspaper.licence: EmoBank v1.4, Buechel and Hahn, EACL 2017. MASC newspaper sentences.
EmoBank newspaper.label_provenance: Human reader and writer valence on a 1-5 scale, averaged in emobank.csv. Negative if valence <= 2.5, positive if valence >= 3.5. The band between those cuts is not assigned a class.
EmoBank newspaper.label_level: Newspaper sentence, not a headline and not a finance label.

NewsMTSC.label_provenance: Five human coders. Kept only where the coders agreed.
NewsMTSC.label_level: Sentiment toward a named person in a political news sentence. Not a headline label.

rejected_sources.name: dnakhla/us-news-headlines-enriched
rejected_sources.reason: Sentiment labels are produced by cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest. They are model output, not human labels, so they are not used as ground truth.

rejected_sources.name: MASHXD/investing_financial_news_headlines
rejected_sources.reason: The card does not say whether the labels are human, market-direction, or automatic. Undocumented labels are not used as ground truth.

rejected_sources.name: Okcan/news-headlines-classifier
rejected_sources.reason: Too small, and the card does not identify who assigned the sentiment labels.

sarcasm_examples: No downloadable news-headline set was found that pairs a human sarcasm mark with a human sentiment label. Sarcasm is recorded as unknown. The project's sarcasm headlines are not assigned a sentiment, because a sarcasm mark is not evidence of negative sentiment.
size_limit: Added MASC newspaper sentences from EmoBank whose human valence is at or below 2.5 or at or above 3.5. The SemEval headlines inside EmoBank are not loaded a second time. Larger headline files found online use a pretrained sentiment model or do not document who labeled them, so they were not added.
